caption: The drawing shows a candle stand composed of a vertical central rod mounted on a three-legged base. The base features three curved feet, each extending outward from the center. Two circular, gold-colored candle holders are attached horizontally and symmetrically to the central rod at about mid-height, each supporting a white candle. The holders are depicted with some detailing, suggesting a reflective metallic surface. Hanging from hooks below the candle holders are two tools, each with thin, elongated handles, possibly for adjusting or trimming the candles. The overall color palette includes shades of black, gray, and gold, with the background rendered in an off-white tone. The piece is signed “J. STALOFF” in the bottom right corner within a rectangular border that frames the drawing.
title: Candlestick Stand
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
